description:
Put a draft, at the revision you read, to the people who may apply it: the organisation's admins, by email with a link, or HandInLoop's operators when it sets what only they may. Free. The plan must validate.

You cannot approve or apply a plan, and no tool does: a person reads it in the portal and applies it there with a passkey, or sends it back with a reason (handinloop_get_onboarding_plan shows it). An edit returns it to draft.

Needs an API key with the 'onboard' scope (#844), which is never on by default: an organisation admin or engineer ticks it on a new key (a key that had 'workflows' before #844 was given it). Without it the call fails naming the scope: ask a person for such a key rather than retrying.

Args:
  - plan_id
  - expected_revision: the revision you read.

Returns: { plan_id, status: "awaiting_approval", revision, link, next_step }. Give the person you work for the link.
name: handinloop_request_plan_approval
title: Ask for an Onboarding Plan's Approval
